defaults.pf_by_load_type_source: Design power factor of an appliance circuit when none is entered (wiring pages, E4): inverter ACs about 0.9 (PFC drive), non-inverter compressors 0.8, resistive heaters (geyser, kettle, iron, heater) 1.0 (pure resistance, same as pf_resistive; Engineer Reviewer 2026-10-15); engineer to confirm
defaults.soiling_rate_max_per_day_source: Upper guard for the dust-loss input (5% of output a day, far above the 0.3%/day planning rate and reported dust-storm losses) so a percent typed as a share (0.3 for 0.3%) is rejected; engineer to confirm
defaults.ac_life_years_source: ASHRAE Handbook HVAC Applications, Owning and Operating Costs chapter, median service life of residential single or split package air conditioners (15 years); N10 reports no payback when the payback is longer than this (audit WL-22); engineer to confirm
defaults.dc_ac_ratio_max_source: Typical string/hybrid inverter DC/AC oversize 1.1-1.3 (manufacturer datasheets' maximum recommended PV input, e.g. 130% of rated AC power); engineer to confirm
defaults.forecast_max_day_whm2_source: Plane-of-array daily irradiation above about 9 kWh/m2 does not occur at Pakistani latitudes (clear-sky maximum); 12,000 Wh/m2 is a safety cap against bad forecast data; engineer to confirm

_meta.rules: Protected: benefit of one previous slab. Unprotected: all units at the rate of the band reached. Fixed charge = Rs/kW/month x sanctioned kW. >=5 kW must be ToU.

peak_hours.applies_to: ex-WAPDA DISCOs (LESCO, IESCO, MEPCO, GEPCO, FESCO, PESCO, HESCO, SEPCO, QESCO, TESCO), consumers on a Time-of-Use meter (5 kW or more sanctioned load); every other hour is off-peak
peak_hours.source: NEPRA tariff determination for IESCO FY2023-24 (schedule of peak and off-peak timings for ToU tariffs); the December to February window is also published by PITC's bill portal
peak_hours.note: Latest NEPRA schedule found is dated 2023; an August 2025 news report says NEPRA asked DISCOs to propose peak hours up to 11 pm only, adoption not confirmed. K-Electric publishes its own timings. Re-check against the current DISCO tariff schedule.

net_billing.buyback_basis: Regulation 14(1)(b): units a prosumer exports are billed at the national average energy purchase price (NAEPP). Regulation 14(3): NEPRA may revise the rate by notification.
net_billing.buyback_source: NEPRA decision on the Power Purchase Price forecast for CY 2026 (7 Jan 2026), para 36: NAEPP Rs 8.13/kWh, NAPPP Rs 25.32/kWh
net_billing.existing_prosumers: Agreements signed before 9 Feb 2026 stay on the rate and mechanism of the repealed 2015 net-metering regulations until they expire (SRO 547(I)/2026, 2 Apr 2026, substitutes regulation 21(2), deemed effective 9 Feb 2026; the first version had set them at the national average power purchase price). A material modification that changes the maximum output (e.g. adding panels) ends those terms early. Renewals move to net billing (regulation 21(3)).
net_billing.note: Size capped at sanctioned load. NAEPP is set for each calendar year in NEPRA's power purchase price decision; re-check every January and when NEPRA notifies a revision. Kept editable for a DISCO that applies a revised rate.

_meta.source: IEC 60364-5-52:2009 Table B.52.4 (PVC insulated copper, two loaded conductors: single-phase and DC) and Table B.52.5 (three loaded conductors: three-phase), 30 C ambient: columns B1 (insulated conductors in conduit on or in a masonry wall; NOT A1, conduit in a thermally insulated wall, which is rated lower) and C (clipped direct). The 1 mm2 row is not in Tables B.52.4/B.52.5 (they start at 1.5 mm2); its values are the same-basis BS 7671 Table 4D1A figures (methods B and C, two and three loaded conductors). Correction factors: Table B.52.14 (ambient air other than 30 C, PVC) and Table B.52.17 row 1 (circuits bunched in air, on a surface, embedded or enclosed). Pakistani n/d sizes converted with formulas.md section W (A = n x pi x (d x 25.4 / 2)^2) and rated as the largest IEC size not above their real area (one rule for every wiring page, conservative).
_meta.status: Engineer to confirm against the IEC tables and Pakistan Cables / Fast Cables datasheets. Every rating is multiplied by the ambient factor (design air temperature, default derating.default_ambient_c, a conservative hot-climate value pending PEC review, editable on the page) and the grouping factor (circuits in one conduit, default 1).
_meta.fields: cables: area_mm2 nominal conductor size; ampacity_a per installation method with two loaded conductors (single-phase, DC); ampacity_3ph_a the same with three loaded conductors (three-phase). pk_sizes: strands, strand diameter in inches, real area, rated_as_mm2 = the largest row of cables whose area is not above the real area (used for its ampacity). derating: ambient_factors and grouping_factors as [value, factor] rows; a value between two rows takes the factor of the next row up (higher temperature, more circuits). breaker_margin_load_types: load types whose MCB is chosen at I_b x margin (continuous motor-type loads), so a 1.5 ton AC gets a 16 A MCB on 2.5 mm2 rather than 10 A on 1 mm2.

methods.B1: In conduit in a brick or plastered (masonry) wall, most Pakistani house wiring; a conduit buried in thermal insulation is method A1 and is rated lower
methods.C: Clipped direct to a wall or surface

mcb_curves._source: IEC 60898-1 instantaneous tripping ranges: B 3-5 x In, C 5-10 x In, D 10-20 x In

B.use: lighting, sockets and resistive loads (heaters, irons, geysers)

C.use: air conditioners, fridges, motors, water pumps and mixed socket circuits

D.use: transformers, welding machines and large motors with heavy inrush

min_area_mm2._source: Lighting 1.0 mm2 copper: BS 7671 Table 52.3 minimum for lighting circuits (IEC 60364-5-52 Table 52.2 sets 1.5 mm2 for power and lighting circuits); other 2.5 mm2 and common Pakistani practice (3/29 for lighting points, 7/29 for sockets and air conditioners); PEC question: is 1.0 mm2 accepted for lighting or is 1.5 mm2 the minimum? Engineer to confirm

derating._source: IEC 60364-5-52:2009 Table B.52.14 (PVC, ambient air) and Table B.52.17 row 1 (bunched in air, on a surface, embedded or enclosed)
derating._status: default_ambient_c is a conservative Pakistani summer design value pending PEC engineer review; ratings at 30 C are kept in the table above
